ap.name: Aladdin's Fortune
ap.hint: Look for the coin meters on each reel — each reel needs a certain number of coins before it turns wild. The more coins already collected (especially on reels 1-3), the better the opportunity.

ap.name: Ascending Fortunes
ap.hint: Watch the five must-hit-by progressive meters — each awards a reel expansion when hit. Look for machines where multiple meters are near their cap simultaneously.

ap.name: Aztec Vault
ap.hint: Check the Aztec Pyramid meter at the top — the more segments already filled, the closer it is to triggering the vault bonus. Any machine showing 7+ of 10 segments filled is worth evaluating.

ap.name: Azure Dragon / Emerald Guardian
ap.hint: Track the four progressive free game meters — each accumulates independently. Look for machines with multiple meters near their trigger thresholds simultaneously for the strongest edge.

ap.name: Boom
ap.hint: Check the BOOM ZONES meter at the top — the closer it is to the must-hit-by value shown, the better your edge. At 80% or more of the way to the cap, the EV is strongly positive.

ap.name: Buccaneer's Gold
ap.hint: Look for the coin meter showing accumulated coins near the trigger threshold. The closer the coin count to the bonus trigger, the stronger the AP opportunity.

ap.name: Buffalo
ap.hint: Look for the buffalo coin meter — the more coins already banked toward the bonus, the stronger the opportunity. Machines at 70%+ of the trigger threshold are worth sitting down at.

ap.name: Buffalo Ascension
ap.hint: Check the Buffalo meter — the more buffalos already collected, the closer you are to the feature. Look for machines with 8+ buffalos already banked.

ap.name: Buffalo Diamond
ap.hint: Three separate free games meters each tied to a 2x, 3x, or 4x win multiplier. Look for machines with heavy accumulation across all three meters — the higher the multiplier meter, the stronger the opportunity.

ap.name: Buffalo Ultimate Stampede
ap.hint: Run up the stampede meter at a low bet level, then switch to a high bet when the meter is close to triggering. The meter persists between bet levels and players.

ap.name: Bustin' Money
ap.hint: Three persistent safes award a combined bonus when triggered. Each safe accumulates independently — look for machines where all three safes are significantly loaded before sitting down.

ap.name: Captain Riches / Tiki Fortune
ap.hint: Coin holders on reels 2, 3, and 4 can turn those reels wild for three spins when triggered. Look for machines with heavy coin accumulation in all three holders — verify carefully as some sources flag this as borderline.

ap.name: Cash Falls
ap.hint: Look for opportunistic fill-in situations where the grid already has coins locked in position. The more coins pre-filled, the stronger the expected value on the next triggered feature.

ap.name: Cashman Bingo
ap.hint: Look for machines where multiple bingo positions are already filled with gold spots. The more positions filled, the closer to a bingo payout — a classic persistent state opportunity.

ap.name: Cats Wild Serengeti
ap.hint: Monitor the four progressive free game meters — each tracks banked free spins separately. Look for machines with 6+ free games already accumulated across multiple meters.

ap.name: Chinese Ultra Rush
ap.hint: A favored target for professional AP players. Look for high coin accumulation on the meter before sitting down. Frequently found on casino floors with overlooked meters.

ap.name: Cleopatra's Vault
ap.hint: Look for the scarab coin meters on each reel — similar to Aladdin's Fortune. More coins collected on reels 1-3 means a stronger opportunity.

ap.name: Coin Catch Cove
ap.hint: Track the persistent diamond countdowns to unlock hidden value. The fewer diamonds remaining in the countdown, the stronger your edge — this is a direct visible-state opportunity.

ap.name: Diamond Mania
ap.hint: A 10-spin cycle game where players collect locking gold frames that turn wild on spin ten. Track which spin in the cycle the machine is on — late-cycle machines with multiple frames locked are the strongest plays.

ap.name: Diamond Thief
ap.hint: Count the diamonds already in the 54-diamond case. If five or fewer diamonds are needed to fill it, you have a strong AP opportunity. The fewer remaining, the better your edge.

ap.name: Eagle Bucks
ap.hint: Check the free games meter — Ainsworth banking games accumulate free spins that carry over. Look for 6+ free games already banked.

ap.name: Easy Money Deluxe
ap.hint: Ten money rolls above the reels each have growing multipliers. Look for machines where multiple rolls have accumulated significant multiplier values — the combined multiplier potential determines your edge.

ap.name: Empire / Empire King
ap.hint: A distance-based timer game — advantageous when the seconds remaining on the timer are at least double the number of stories left to climb. Check the ratio before sitting.

ap.name: Fort Knox
ap.hint: Count the digits already collected toward unlocking the vault. The more digits filled in, the closer to the bonus. Look for machines at 70%+ of the way to completion.

ap.name: Frankenstein
ap.hint: A persistent prize array above the reels can be supercharged with multipliers. Look for machines where the array is loaded with high-value prizes and active multipliers before sitting down.

ap.name: Golden Egypt
ap.hint: Look for two of the first three reels to be one coin away from turning wild, plus at least one additional coin in the "Bad Zone" (reels 4 and 5); alternatively, any machine with four or five coins total across the board is a go.

ap.name: Golden Egypt Grand
ap.hint: A larger reel format (2-3-4-3-2) version of Golden Egypt with persistent coin holders. Same core mechanic — look for heavy coin accumulation on reels 1-3. The larger format means more potential wild coverage.

ap.name: Golden Jungle
ap.hint: Identify how many Buddha symbols have already been collected — each Buddha collected fills a reel toward going wild. Look for machines with 3+ Buddhas already banked, especially if they are on reels 1-3.

ap.name: Grand Buddha Link / Grand Cat Link
ap.hint: Sticky multipliers from line-hit symbols persist for an 8-spin countdown. Look for machines mid-countdown with multiple multipliers still active — the more multipliers remaining, the stronger your expected value.

ap.name: Green Machine
ap.hint: Listed by professional hustlers as a top AP target. Look for high meter accumulation. Often overlooked on casino floors, making it a high-value find.

ap.name: Happy 8s
ap.hint: An 8-game cycle machine. Track which spin in the cycle the machine is on — late-cycle spins with loaded state are the strongest plays. Same category as Scarab.

ap.name: Heavenly Riches
ap.hint: Target when the Red Ribbon and Minor progressives are higher than their typical baseline. The further above baseline, the stronger your positive expected value.

ap.name: Hexbreaker
ap.hint: Look at the reel position height indicator — the higher the reels are positioned, the closer to the bonus. Any reel at height 6+ is worth noting; height 8 on reels 2 or 4 under a Luck Zone is a strong signal.

ap.name: Huff N' Puff
ap.hint: Players collect and upgrade frames over several spins. Look for machines with multiple upgraded frames already built — the higher the frame upgrade level, the stronger the bonus potential when triggered.

ap.name: Hyper Orbs
ap.hint: Collect orbs to fill a persistent meter toward a free games bonus. Look for machines with 10 or more of the 15 required orbs already collected — the closer to 15, the stronger the edge.

ap.name: Isle of Pearls / Jungle King
ap.hint: Variation of the Empire mechanics — involves climbing or diving distance versus a timer. Advantageous when distance remaining is significantly less than time remaining.

ap.name: Jade Monkey
ap.hint: A commonly cited AP target. Look for strong accumulation on the meter before committing. Often found alongside Diamond Devils which uses the same core mechanic.

ap.name: Jin Ji Bao Xi Grand
ap.hint: A powerful sticky wild mechanic persists between players. Look for machines with multiple sticky wilds already locked in position — the more wilds locked, the stronger your starting position.

ap.name: Jungle Riches
ap.hint: Track the Trigger Tiles on each persistent reel set — the fewer tiles remaining and the closer they are to the left side of the reels, the stronger your edge. Five separate persistent reel sets exist per bet level, so check all bet levels before moving on. Any reel set showing 1-2 tiles remaining is a strong play.

ap.name: Kingdom of Ice
ap.hint: Recommended as a starter AP machine for new advantage players due to its low volatility. Look for strong meter accumulation — the mechanic is straightforward and easy to read.

ap.name: Lucky Lemmings Stampede
ap.hint: Lemming symbols move down one row with each spin. Look for machines where multiple lemmings are already near the bottom rows — the lower the lemmings, the closer to the bonus trigger.

ap.name: Lucky Pick
ap.hint: A persistent 21-space pick board accumulates enhancements toward a free games bonus. Cited as highly lucrative but complex — look for machines with significant board positions already filled before sitting down.

ap.name: Magic Rockets
ap.hint: A more volatile version of Magic Treasures featuring cascade progressives. Same money ball collection mechanic — look for machines with heavy ball accumulation. Higher volatility means larger bankroll requirements.

ap.name: Magic Treasures
ap.hint: Available in Dragon and Tiger versions. A gathering game where money balls already collected persist for a randomly triggered bonus. The more balls gathered, the stronger the starting position.

ap.name: Magic Treasures Gold
ap.hint: An upgraded version of Magic Treasures with three progressive money ball treasures instead of one. Look for machines with heavy accumulation across all three treasure meters simultaneously.

ap.name: Mining Mayhem Gold
ap.hint: Five persistent credit chests above the reels accumulate value independently. Look for machines where multiple chests are heavily loaded — the combined chest value determines your edge.

ap.name: Money Galaxy
ap.hint: Check the coin collection meter — Money Galaxy banks coins that persist between players. Look for machines at 70%+ of the coin threshold before the bonus triggers.

ap.name: Moneyball
ap.hint: Listed as a top AP machine by professional hustlers. Check the coin accumulation meter before sitting. High floors with multiple units make this a frequent find.

ap.name: Mustang Money
ap.hint: Check the free games meter — same Ainsworth banking mechanic as Eagle Bucks and Thunder Cash. Look for 6+ free games already accumulated.

ap.name: Ocean Magic
ap.hint: Look at the bubble symbol overlays on the reels — when bubbles align over the right symbols, they trigger wild reels. Look for machines where multiple bubble stacks are already in strong positions on reels 1-3.

ap.name: Ocean Magic Grand
ap.hint: Wild bubbles float up the reels and persist between players. Same core mechanic as Ocean Magic — look for multiple bubble stacks already in strong positions on reels 1-3. The Grand format offers larger potential coverage.

ap.name: Phoenix Link
ap.hint: A counter resets between 100 and 1,500 spins and must hit before spin 1,888. Track the current counter position — when the counter is within 200 spins of the must-hit cap, the EV is strongly positive.

ap.name: Piggy Bankin'
ap.hint: Look for the coin total in the piggy bank display — the closer to the Break the Bank threshold (typically shown on screen), the stronger the opportunity. At 80%+ of the way there, sit down.

ap.name: Pillars of Cash
ap.hint: Five persistent prize pillars — one per reel — grow in height as coins are added. Look for machines where multiple pillars are at or near maximum height. Spin counter also contributes to the trigger condition.

ap.name: Plants vs. Zombies
ap.hint: Watch the Brain Meter — the closer it is to 500, the more likely the bonus trigger. Any machine showing 400+ brains already accumulated is a strong AP target.

ap.name: Power Push
ap.hint: Simulates a coin pusher with prizes collected in stacks above the reels. Guaranteed trigger after 12 full stacks or 300 coins. Count the current stacks — at 10+ stacks already loaded, the EV is strongly positive.

ap.name: Prosperity Pearl
ap.hint: Target when the machine has seven or more banked Wilds already accumulated. The more Wilds banked beyond seven, the stronger the opportunity.

ap.name: Quick Hit Ultra Pays
ap.hint: Uncapped progressive meters create AP opportunities as values climb above typical reset levels. Look for machines where progressive values significantly exceed the baseline reset amount across multiple meters.

ap.name: Raise the Sails
ap.hint: Accumulate silver, bronze, and gold coins toward the free games trigger. Look for machines with heavy accumulation across all three coin types before the threshold.

ap.name: Rakin' Bacon
ap.hint: Monitor the Mini and Minor progressives — when both are significantly above their reset values, the machine is in positive EV territory. A popular machine that gets overlooked.

ap.name: Red Ball
ap.hint: Profitable when the bonus under either 3x3 square is 20+ credits, or when both squares show 15+ credits. Check both squares before sitting — the combined value determines your edge.

ap.name: Red Silk / Aztec Chief
ap.hint: Look specifically for reels that are already active and wild when you approach the machine. The persistent wild state is the entire edge — if no reels are wild, move on.

ap.name: Regal Link
ap.hint: Five must-hit-by wild and free-games meters using cash wilds instead of standard wilds. Look for machines where multiple meters are near their caps simultaneously — stronger than Regal Riches due to additional meter count.

ap.name: Regal Riches
ap.hint: Target the Minor, Major, and Mega wild counters — when multiple counters are near their must-hit-by caps simultaneously, the EV is strongly positive.

ap.name: Rich Little Piggies / Rich Little Hens
ap.hint: Three progressive free-games features that grow visually as they accumulate. Not must-hit-by — verify current meter levels before playing. Some sources flag this as a perceived persistence trap; confirm mechanic at the machine.

ap.name: River Dragons / Fire Wolf 2 / Forest Dragons
ap.hint: Two must-hit-by progressive jackpots cited at approximately $500 and $5,000 cap values. When either progressive is close to its must-hit cap, the EV is strongly positive. Check both jackpot levels before sitting.

ap.name: Rocket Rumble
ap.hint: Four must-hit-by progressive free-games meters each with distinct caps. Look for machines where multiple meters are near their must-hit values simultaneously — the combined probability creates strong positive EV.

ap.name: S&H Green Stamps
ap.hint: Fill books of stamps — advantageous when a book is roughly half-filled (600+ stamps already collected). Low volatility makes this ideal for AP beginners. Easy meter to read.

ap.name: Safe Buster / Safe Cracker
ap.hint: Target dollar machines with 20+ coins in the safe, or quarter machines with 25+ coins. The coin count in the safe display is visible and easy to check before sitting.

ap.name: San Xing Riches
ap.hint: An Asian-themed version of Raise the Sails with three persistent free games meters. Same core mechanic — look for machines with significant free spins already banked across all three meters before sitting.

ap.name: Scarab
ap.hint: Identify which spin number the machine is on within its 10-spin cycle. Spins 7-10 with loaded wild reels are the strongest plays — look for machines where multiple reels already have scarab symbols stacked.

ap.name: Shopping Spree
ap.hint: Target when the frequent shopper points counter is at 29 or 30+ points. The counter is clearly displayed and resets after the bonus — look for machines left at high counts.

ap.name: Stack Up Pays
ap.hint: Five must-hit-by progressive meters each award reel expansions when hit. Same family as Ascending Fortunes — look for machines where multiple meters are near their caps simultaneously for the strongest combined edge.

ap.name: Star Goddess / Wu Dragon
ap.hint: Persistent frames turn wild when hit by fireball symbols. Look for machines with multiple frames already positioned on high-value reel locations — the more frames active, the stronger the wild coverage potential.

ap.name: Sumo Kitty / Lucha Kitty
ap.hint: Persistent gold frames connect and award credit values when linked. Look for machines with multiple frames already positioned near each other — connected frames multiply the credit award value significantly.

ap.name: Super 7s
ap.hint: Target when at least three square sevens are already showing on the reels. The more square sevens visible, the stronger the opportunity — this is a quick visual check.

ap.name: Super Lit Vegas
ap.hint: A 7-spin cycle where players collect electric orbs to turn frames wild. Track which spin in the cycle the machine is on — late-cycle machines with multiple orbs already collected are the strongest plays.

ap.name: Sword of Destiny / Angel Blade
ap.hint: A 10-spin cycle machine similar to Scarab. Track which spin the machine is on — late-cycle spins with loaded state are the strongest plays. Check multiple bet levels as cycles may differ per denomination.

ap.name: Temperature's Rising
ap.hint: Advantageous when the bonus amount displayed is greater than the degrees still needed to break the thermometer. Simple math check — bonus value vs degrees remaining.

ap.name: Temple Falls
ap.hint: A massive 5x7 grid of persistent prize coins displayed above the reels. Coins drop onto the reels and award prizes. Look for machines with heavy grid loading — count visible coins before sitting.

ap.name: The Enforcer
ap.hint: Check the must-hit-by value displayed on the machine versus the current jackpot amount. When the gap between current value and the must-hit-by cap is small (under 15%), the EV is strongly positive.

ap.name: Thunder Cash
ap.hint: Check the free games meter — Ainsworth banking mechanic identical to Eagle Bucks and Mustang Money. Look for 6+ free games already banked before sitting down.

ap.name: Treasure Blast
ap.hint: A unique outer rim of prizes drops down onto the reels with each spin. Look for machines with high-value prizes positioned at the top of the rim — those drop first and represent the strongest immediate opportunity.

ap.name: Treasure Box: Kingdom / Dynasty
ap.hint: A coin/key meter reduces the coins needed for a respin bonus. Target machines where 4 or fewer coins are needed to complete the meter — at this threshold the expected value is strongly positive. Easy visual check at the machine.

ap.name: Triple Cash Winfall
ap.hint: A fishing and money version of Double Diamond Mine. Uses the same stack-based thresholds — look for machines with heavy stack accumulation near the trigger point.

ap.name: Triple Double Diamond
ap.hint: Watch the must-hit-by progressive meter — when the current jackpot is within 10-15% of the displayed cap, the machine is in positive EV territory.

ap.name: Ultimate Jackbox
ap.hint: A volatile machine — target when multiple coins are already filled to trigger double Wilds. The more coins pre-filled, the stronger your starting position for the feature.

ap.name: Ultra Rush Gold
ap.hint: Gold scatter symbols lock and reset the spin counter. Related to Chinese Ultra Rush but distinct Gold family mechanic. Look for machines with multiple gold symbols already locked — each lock reduces the spins needed for the bonus.

ap.name: Voodoo Jackpots
ap.hint: Advantageous when the Voodoo Doll character meters are high, indicating a large number of starting free spins already accumulated. Higher meters mean more free spins on trigger.

ap.name: Wheel of Fortune
ap.hint: Check the must-hit-by progressive meter displayed on the machine. When the jackpot is close to the cap (within 10-15%), the edge is yours.

ap.name: Wheel of Fortune 4D
ap.hint: Similar to Golden Egypt — collected dollar symbols turn reels wild for two spins. Look for machines with strong dollar symbol accumulation on reels 1-3. The 4D effects confirm reel positions making state easy to read.

ap.name: Wheel of Fortune High Roller
ap.hint: A variable state machine — higher reel positions increase the likelihood of hitting the top bonus and line counts. Check reel height indicators before sitting down.

ap.name: Wild Cherry Pie
ap.hint: Target based on the number of empty spots remaining in the pie display. The fewer empty spots left, the closer to the bonus trigger. An easy visual read on any casino floor.

ap.name: Wolf Run Eclipse
ap.hint: Players bank free spins on Mini, Minor, Major, and Mega wheels. Look for machines with significant free spins already banked across multiple wheel tiers.

ap.name: Wonder 4 Collection
ap.hint: A cabinet playing four classic games simultaneously with collection meters for red and blue free-games features. Look for machines where multiple game meters are loaded across the four simultaneous games.

ap.name: Wu Jin Pen: Fuyu Phoenix / Panda
ap.hint: A persistent bowl spin counter increments and affects the hold-and-spin bonus value. Look for machines where the bowl counter is significantly elevated — higher counts mean larger hold-and-spin prize values.

ap.name: X-Factor
ap.hint: Only worth playing when the multiplier has reached 6X or higher. Check the multiplier display before sitting — below 6X the edge is insufficient to justify play.

ap.name: Zhao Cai Zhu
ap.hint: Red, green, and blue pig lantern meters each have must-hit-by counts and frame upgrade features. Look for machines where multiple lantern meters are near their must-hit caps simultaneously for the strongest combined edge.

ap.name: Zodiac Lion / Zodiac Dragon
ap.hint: Persistent gold frames become wild when connected by head symbols. Look for machines with multiple frames already positioned adjacent to each other — connected frames create wild reels and dramatically increase win potential.

ap.name: Zorro: Power of Z
ap.hint: A 10-spin cycle machine offering quick advantage plays. Track which spin the machine is on — late-cycle machines are the target. The quick cycle length means opportunities appear and disappear faster than longer-cycle games.

notAp.name: Cash Raccoons
notAp.reason: Confirmed AP trap — the persistence visual is misleading. No exploitable state exists. Multiple AP sources explicitly warn against this machine.

notAp.name: Dancing Drums
notAp.reason: Pot filling is visual only — no exploitable persistent state

notAp.name: Dragon Link
notAp.reason: No persistent state — same RNG mechanic as Lightning Link

notAp.name: Fire Light Eruption
notAp.reason: Borderline AP trap — appears to have persistent state but edge is negligible or negative in practice. High risk of misidentification as a beatable machine.

notAp.name: Flush Attack
notAp.reason: Banking video poker — target only when Flush Attack mode is active after required flushes. Without active mode, no edge exists.

notAp.name: Icy Wilds
notAp.reason: Wild persists for one spin only — no meaningful exploitable edge

notAp.name: Jacks or Better Playoff
notAp.reason: AP only when bonus pot contains 145+ credits. Below that threshold, no mathematical edge.

notAp.name: Lightning Link
notAp.reason: No persistent state — pure RNG, no accumulator mechanic

notAp.name: Super Burst Cartin' Gold
notAp.reason: Never positive EV — confirmed by multiple AP sources. The feature trigger appears tied to visible state but is purely RNG-driven. Do not play under any circumstances.
